text: dsh-custom-workspace 是面向 DSH Web 的工作区外观插件，为每个 Workspace 单独保存显示偏好。它在通用设置中加入“Workspace 外观”入口，并根据当前会话所属工作区将配置应用到页面。用户可以设置工作区背景颜色或图片、Markdown 正文字号与行高、段落和列表等内容的间距，以及 Retina 字体渲染方式；也可以恢复该工作区的默认外观。适合希望为不同工作区分别调整阅读体验的 DSH Web 用户。设置经本机 DSH 的 loopback RPC 保存，不需要额外 API Key。

dsh-custom-workspace customizes each DSH Web workspace. It adds a General Settings entry and applies preferences for the active workspace. Set its background, Markdown size, line height, block spacing, or Retina rendering, then restore defaults. Settings use DSH loopback RPC; no API key is needed.

dsh-custom-workspace 的功能「工作区背景」：为选定 Workspace 设置背景颜色或图片 URL，插件把背景应用到主工作区页面；在通用设置的 Workspace 外观弹窗中编辑。
dsh-custom-workspace 的功能「Markdown 字体与行高」：为当前工作区调整 Markdown 正文字号和行高，呈现层同步更新正文及强调文本样式。
dsh-custom-workspace 的功能「Markdown 区块间距」：设置段落、列表、标题、引用及代码块的间距，设置后在该工作区的会话 Markdown 内容中呈现。
dsh-custom-workspace 的功能「Retina 字体渲染」：切换工作区的 Retina 字体渲染选项，插件据此设置页面字体抗锯齿样式。
dsh-custom-workspace 的功能「恢复工作区默认」：清除所选工作区保存的外观设置并恢复默认值；在 Workspace 外观弹窗点击“恢复默认”。
dsh-custom-workspace 的设置 RPC 只接受 loopback 浏览器会话；通过 LAN 主机名访问时设置不可用。背景图片使用填写的 URL 直接加载，显示依赖浏览器网络和内容安全策略。
不同工作区能分别保存自己的外观设置吗？

dsh-custom-workspace README · dsh-custom-workspace：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

An external [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web plugin that gives each workspace its own background, chat font size, line height, Markdown block spacing, and font-rendering preference.

dsh-custom-workspace README · Features：- Background color or image URL for the main workspace surface.
- Independent Markdown body font size and line height.
- Markdown block spacing for paragraphs, lists, headings, quotes, and code blocks.
- Grayscale antialiasing toggle for Retina displays.
- Per-workspace persistence in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`.

dsh-custom-workspace README · Features：The active appearance follows the workspace containing the current session and falls back to the most recently selected workspace. Workspaces without an override inherit the active DSH theme.

dsh-custom-workspace README · Examples：Theme defaults (font and spacing inherit from DSH):

Compact reading — `13px` font, `20px` line height, `4px` block spacing, `#eef4ff` background:

Spacious reading — `20px` font, `38px` line height, `28px` block spacing, `#fff3e8` background:

dsh-custom-workspace README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6`.
- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`.
- A loopback DSH Web session. The settings RPC intentionally rejects non-loopback browsers.

dsh-custom-workspace README · Install：Install the published package into the Web profile, then restart DSH:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-custom-workspace
dsh web
```

Open **Settings → General Settings → Workspace Appearance** to configure the selected workspace. Changes are saved immediately.

To remove the plugin:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-custom-workspace
```

dsh-custom-workspace README · Develop：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run verify
dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD
pnpm run watch

Host changes in `src/index.ts` require a DSH restart. Browser changes under `src/client/` are rebuilt by the watcher and loaded through DSH client HMR.

Run the optional browser smoke test against a running Web profile after installing Playwright Chromium:

```sh
pnpm exec playwright install chromium
pnpm run verify:browser -- http://127.0.0.1:3081
```

dsh-custom-workspace README · Persistence and security：The Host half owns the `custom-workspace` settings namespace. DSH does not expose third-party namespaces through its generic settings API, so this plugin registers a dedicated `/custom-workspace` Connection RPC channel. The channel accepts loopback requests only and exposes no other settings namespace.

The browser half validates every response before publishing it to the presenter. Failed writes reload the Host value; a disconnected or non-loopback browser marks the scope unavailable.
dsh-custom-workspace README · Model Experience：None. Workspace appearance affects only browser presentation and never reaches a model request or session log.

dsh-custom-workspace README · Known Limitations：- Settings are unavailable to browsers reached through a LAN hostname, even when the DSH Web server trusts that hostname.
- Background images use the configured URL directly and depend on the browser's network and content-security policy.
- This release targets DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`; pre-release DSH APIs may change without compatibility shims.
